sequences.notes: Three players, 5/10 blinds, 1,000 chips each. Every chip is visible in every frame.
Heads-up: a preflop frame, then the turn. The flop and its betting were never captured.
The pot grows from 60 to 120 while two stacks are unreadable, so who put in what is unknown.
The reader takes the 7♣ on the flop for a 7♠ on the turn, which contradicts the earlier frame.
Ash is all-in for 200 and wins the main pot; you win the 600 side pot from Blake.
Five frames from preflop to showdown with an unreadable name, a hidden folded player, a misread card to correct, one interval with confirmed actions, and unresolved gaps.
Three photos of one physical hand.

notes: Drawn tables made for this project. Truth comes from the drawing definitions; the stored readings are the mock predictions and include deliberate mistakes. Scores on synthetic drawings say nothing about accuracy on real images.
